tools.name: create_bond
tools.description: Create a continuity bond (premium 0.1% of posted collateral per 30-day period; first bond's first period waived once per operator account and payer wallet); coverage may not exceed collateral

tools.name: heartbeat
tools.description: Signed heartbeat for a bond (HMAC-SHA256 with the bond's agent secret)

tools.name: evaluate_bond
tools.description: Evaluate a bond: dual-condition payout (ledger deadline AND 2-of-3 witness quorum), UNRESOLVED fail-closed

tools.name: bond_standing
tools.description: Bond standing query ($0.001): state, collateral, premium, paid_cents — never the agent secret

tools.name: witness_status
tools.description: Witness status query ($0.001): per-witness online state + key fingerprints
